# Generated Code Structure

The generator produces two files via `context.AddSource(...)`. Both are placed in the `MediatorLite.Generated` namespace with `// <auto-generated />` headers and `#nullable enable`.

---

## MediatorLiteRegistration.g.cs

### Namespace & Class

```csharp
namespace MediatorLite.Generated
{
    public static class MediatorLiteRegistration
    {
        // Extension methods on IServiceCollection
        // Static count properties
    }
}
```

### Methods

#### `AddGeneratedHandlers(this IServiceCollection services)`

All-in-one method. Calls the four granular methods in order:

1. `AddGeneratedRequestHandlers(services)`
2. `AddGeneratedNotificationHandlers(services)`
3. `AddGeneratedValidators(services)`
4. `AddGeneratedBehaviors(services)`

Then registers the source-generated mediator:

```csharp
services.AddSingleton<global::MediatorLite.ISourceGeneratedMediator, SourceGeneratedMediator>();
```

Returns `services` for chaining.

#### `AddGeneratedRequestHandlers(this IServiceCollection services)`

Emits one `AddTransient` per discovered handler:

```csharp
services.AddTransient<global::MediatorLite.IRequestHandler<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand, global::MediatorLite.Unit>, global::MyApp.Handlers.CreateOrderCommandHandler>();
```

#### `AddGeneratedNotificationHandlers(this IServiceCollection services)`

Similar pattern — one `AddTransient` per notification handler interface:

```csharp
services.AddTransient<global::MediatorLite.INotificationHandler<global::MyApp.UserCreatedNotification>, global::MyApp.Notifications.SendWelcomeEmailHandler>();
```

#### `AddGeneratedValidators(this IServiceCollection services)`

Two categories of registrations:

1. **Custom validators** — discovered concrete `IValidator<T>` implementations:
   ```csharp
   services.AddTransient<global::MediatorLite.Validation.IValidator<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand>, global::MyApp.Validators.CreateOrderCommandValidator>();
   ```

2. **DataAnnotationsValidator auto-registrations** — for request types whose properties carry DataAnnotation attributes:
   ```csharp
   services.AddTransient<global::MediatorLite.Validation.IValidator<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand>, global::MediatorLite.Validation.DataAnnotationsValidator<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand>>();
   ```

#### `AddGeneratedBehaviors(this IServiceCollection services)`

Emits behavior registrations in a specific order:

1. **ValidationBehavior first** — for each request type that needs validation:
   ```csharp
   // Validation behaviors (registered first to ensure validation runs before other behaviors)
   services.AddTransient<global::MediatorLite.IPipelineBehavior<TReq, TRes>, global::MediatorLite.Validation.ValidationBehavior<TReq, TRes>>();
   ```

2. **Other expanded behaviors** — all non-validation behaviors (open generics already closed over each request/response pair):
   ```csharp
   services.AddTransient<global::MediatorLite.IPipelineBehavior<TReq, TRes>, global::MyApp.LoggingBehavior<TReq, TRes>>();
   ```

### Count Properties

```csharp
public static int RequestHandlerCount => N;
public static int NotificationHandlerCount => N;
public static int BehaviorCount => N;      // includes validation behaviors
public static int ValidatorCount => N;     // includes DataAnnotation auto-validators
```

### Empty Registration Fallback

When no handlers are discovered, `GenerateEmptyRegistration` produces a minimal class where all methods return `services` unchanged and all counts are `0`. No `SourceGeneratedMediator` is generated or registered in this case.

---

## SourceGeneratedMediator.g.cs

### Class Structure

```csharp
namespace MediatorLite.Generated
{
    public sealed class SourceGeneratedMediator : global::MediatorLite.ISourceGeneratedMediator
    {
        // Static dictionaries (handler order, notification options)
        // ISourceGeneratedMediator method implementations
        // Per-request helper methods
        // DispatchAs helper
    }
}
```

### Static Dictionaries

#### `_handlerOrderMap`

Only generated when notification handlers with `[NotificationHandlerOrder]` exist:

```csharp
private static readonly Dictionary<string, int> _handlerOrderMap = new(StringComparer.Ordinal)
{
    { "MyApp.Notifications.CreateAuditLogHandler", 1 },
    { "MyApp.Notifications.SendWelcomeEmailHandler", 2 },
};
```

Keys are handler FQNs with `global::` stripped.

#### `_notificationOptionsMap`

Only generated when `[NotificationOptions]`-decorated notifications exist:

```csharp
private static readonly Dictionary<string, (global::MediatorLite.NotificationExecutionStrategy, global::MediatorLite.NotificationErrorStrategy)> _notificationOptionsMap = new(StringComparer.Ordinal)
{
    { "MyApp.UserCreatedNotification", ((global::MediatorLite.NotificationExecutionStrategy)0, (global::MediatorLite.NotificationErrorStrategy)1) },
};
```

Keys are notification type FQNs with `global::` stripped. Values are enum ints cast to the strategy types.

### Method Implementations

#### `TrySendAsync<TResponse>`

Pattern-matching switch on the request instance:

```csharp
return request switch
{
    global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand r => DispatchAs<TResponse, global::MediatorLite.Unit>(
        serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<global::MediatorLite.IRequestHandler<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand, global::MediatorLite.Unit>>().HandleAsync(r, cancellationToken)),
    _ => null,
};
```

Returns `null` for unknown request types, triggering reflection-based fallback in the core mediator.

#### `TryInvokeHandlerAsync<TResponse>`

Identical switch structure to `TrySendAsync`. Used when behaviors are present — the pipeline calls this for the innermost handler invocation.

#### `TryGetHandlerOrder(Type handlerType)`

```csharp
return _handlerOrderMap.TryGetValue(handlerType.FullName ?? string.Empty, out var order) ? order : null;
```

Returns `null` when no ordered handlers were discovered (dictionary not generated, method returns `null` directly).

#### `TryGetNotificationOptions(Type notificationType)`

```csharp
return _notificationOptionsMap.TryGetValue(notificationType.FullName ?? string.Empty, out var options) ? options : null;
```

Returns `null` when no notification options were discovered.

#### `TryGetCachedHandlers<TNotification>`

Type switch resolving handlers by notification type:

```csharp
var notificationType = typeof(TNotification);
try
{
    return notificationType switch
    {
        Type t when t == typeof(global::MyApp.UserCreatedNotification) => new List<global::MediatorLite.INotificationHandler<TNotification>>
        {
            (global::MediatorLite.INotificationHandler<TNotification>)(object)serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<global::MyApp.SendWelcomeEmailHandler>(),
            (global::MediatorLite.INotificationHandler<TNotification>)(object)serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<global::MyApp.CreateAuditLogHandler>(),
        }.AsReadOnly(),
        _ => null,
    };
}
catch (InvalidOperationException)
{
    return null;
}
```

Note: Resolves handler by concrete class type (`GetRequiredService<ConcreteHandler>()`) and casts to `INotificationHandler<TNotification>` via double cast `(INotificationHandler<T>)(object)`. The `try/catch` around `InvalidOperationException` handles cases where handlers aren't registered.

#### `TryResolveBehaviors(IServiceProvider, Type requestType, Type responseType)`

Tuple pattern match dispatching to per-request helper methods:

```csharp
return (requestType, responseType) switch
{
    (Type t, Type r) when t == typeof(global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand) && r == typeof(global::MediatorLite.Unit) =>
        ResolveBehaviorsFor_MyApp_Commands_CreateOrderCommand(serviceProvider),
    _ => null,
};
```

##### Per-request helper: `ResolveBehaviorsFor_{SafeName}`

```csharp
private static List<object> ResolveBehaviorsFor_MyApp_Commands_CreateOrderCommand(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
{
    var behaviors = new List<object>();
    foreach (var behavior in serviceProvider.GetServices<global::MediatorLite.IPipelineBehavior<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand, global::MediatorLite.Unit>>())
    {
        if (behavior != null)
            behaviors.Add(behavior);
    }
    return behaviors;
}
```

Method name uses `GetSafeTypeName` to convert the request type FQN to a valid C# identifier.

#### `InvokeHandler<TResponse>`

Tuple pattern matching on `(requestType, typeof(TResponse))`:

```csharp
return (requestType, typeof(TResponse)) switch
{
    (Type t, Type r) when t == typeof(global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand) && r == typeof(global::MediatorLite.Unit) =>
        (ValueTask<TResponse>)(object)(((global::MediatorLite.IRequestHandler<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand, global::MediatorLite.Unit>)handler).HandleAsync((global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand)request, cancellationToken)),

    _ => throw new InvalidOperationException(
        $"No source-generated handler for request type {requestType.FullName}.")
};
```

Casts `handler` (received as `object`) to the concrete handler interface and `request` to the concrete request type. Result is box-cast to `ValueTask<TResponse>`.

#### `InvokeBehavior<TResponse>`

Triple-tuple pattern matching on `(requestType, typeof(TResponse), behaviorType)`:

```csharp
return (requestType, typeof(TResponse), behaviorType) switch
{
    (Type t, Type r, Type b)
        when t == typeof(global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand)
        && r == typeof(global::MediatorLite.Unit)
        && b == typeof(global::MyApp.LoggingBehavior<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand, global::MediatorLite.Unit>) =>
        (ValueTask<TResponse>)(object)(((global::MediatorLite.IPipelineBehavior<global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand, global::MediatorLite.Unit>)behavior).HandleAsync(
            (global::MyApp.CreateOrderCommand)request,
            (global::MediatorLite.RequestHandlerDelegate<global::MediatorLite.Unit>)(object)next,
            cancellationToken)),

    _ => throw new InvalidOperationException(
        $"No source-generated behavior invoker for {behaviorType.Name} on {requestType.Name}.")
};
```

One arm is generated per `ExpandedBehaviorInfo` (including validation behaviors). The `next` delegate is cast from `RequestHandlerDelegate<TResponse>` to the concrete response-typed delegate.

### `DispatchAs` Helper

```csharp
private static async ValueTask<TResponse> DispatchAs<TResponse, TActual>(ValueTask<TActual> task)
{
    var result = await task.ConfigureAwait(false);
    return (TResponse)(object)result!;
}
```

Bridges the gap between the concrete `ValueTask<TActual>` returned by a handler and the generic `ValueTask<TResponse>` expected by the caller. Uses `ConfigureAwait(false)` and box-cast.
